name: Sayonara, Kami-sama.
source:
The world abandoned by Gods. There is a feeling in the air that this unjust world is going to be wiped out to prepare space for a new world.
Main character is a crippled orphan on the ruins of a town. He meets strange people and remnants of civilization.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
被诸神遗弃的世界。空气中有一种感觉，这个不公正的世界将被消灭，为新世界准备空间。
主角是一个小镇废墟上的残疾孤儿。他遇到了陌生的人和文明的残余。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
